statement: The actual closed-subset contraction of C76 enlarges to every principal strip with abelian effective base image, including strips with full-real endpoint-stabilizer character images. The exact base image is topologically conjugate to R translations; prescribing its source translation character together with both finite endpoint characters gives an actual vector image of dimension at most three. Five original prefix letters realize each required fractional vector, and fifteen short increments provide the compact lower-limit corrections. One global compact family controls both maps and inverses at all interior and original-circle accumulations. On each remaining nonabelian strip, the actual source derived subgroup has transitive base image, the endpoint vector image of every base stabilizer is the full vector space, and the specified Polish path-group quotient is homeomorphic to the transitive character/base target with compact local preimages.
depends_on: C37 exact topology and conjugacy of transitive abelian line actions; C50.3 five-letter additive path identity; C75 actual principal strips and characters; C76 compact source families, simultaneous endpoint selection, exact restriction morphism and all frontier controls; C30 verified Polish orbit-open-map theorem and C64 proved compact-covering lemma
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b), enlargement of the actual one-dimensional proper-operator filling and exact remaining character/base quotient.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The effective abelian base image is compared by its actual evaluation homeomorphism, while the source character is separately given by evaluation. The joint vector image is proved to be a real subspace before taking closure. The nonabelian comparison retains its action kernel and actual stabilizer quotient, and uses paths to actual finite words for transitivity.
computational_checks: This qualitative continuation uses the previously proved exact five-letter path identity. The character dimensions, fifteen-increment neighborhood count, operator equations, compact products, quotient maps and all forward/inverse limits are proved directly; no new numerical or finite computation is required.
notes: The actual restriction morphism is retained for the enlarged closed subset; no lift through excluded strips is inferred. All remaining excluded strips have nonabelian base image and a nonzero endpoint character. Their precise path-group orbit map is open and has compact local preimages, but a continuous uniformly controlled selection for targets escaping toward endpoints remains unresolved. The contraction need not equal the earlier independently selected C76 homotopy on interior strips; restriction gives the exact relation between their target spaces.
